```yaml
name: Smoke Test Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build Fedify test harness
      run: npm run build --prefix test/smoke/harness

    - name: Start Mastodon stack
      run: docker-compose -f test/smoke/docker-compose.yml up -d

    - name: Run smoke tests
      run: deno run test/smoke/orchestrator.ts

    - name: Stop Mastodon stack
      run: docker-compose -f test/smoke/docker-compose.yml down
```
